TIN_INVESTIGATION:

Alert: SHINYHUNTERS_POST_AUTH_MFA_MANIPULATION
Verdict: False Positive (High Confidence)

Okta account s.hudson flagged for post-vishing takeover. Failed logins from
149.50.97.144, then a successful auth, then immediate activation of a new
Okta Passkey from an Android emulator (user agent contains Genymobile/Phone).

SIEM searches for that user agent and for 149.50.97.144 across six days found
the activity isolated to s.hudson. No lateral movement to other accounts.

comments.author: Automation
comments.text:
GEMINI_FINDINGS:

Analyst-initiated Gemini investigation of Salesforce events from
149.50.97.144.

11:03-11:05 UTC: document searches for confidential, internal, trading
strategy, portfolio, proposal.

11:08:03-11:08:25 UTC: 7 documents downloaded, user agent
python-requests/2.31.0 (scripted, not a browser):
  Q4_Investment_Report_Confidential.pdf
  Client_Portfolio_2026_Internal.xlsx
  Trading_Strategy_Confidential_2026.docx
  Board_Deck_Internal_Jan2026.pptx
  M&A_Proposal_Confidential_Draft.pdf
  Investor_Relations_Q4_Confidential.pdf
  Fund_Performance_Internal_YTD.xlsx

11:20 UTC: POST to the Salesforce Aura endpoint, likely data staging.

Assessment: automated bulk exfiltration. Regulatory exposure under SEC Rule
17a-4, SOX and MNPI.

comments.author: Automation
comments.text:
EVIDENCE ASSESSMENT

Verdict assessment: revise
Recommended priority: Critical
Evidence sufficiency: partial
Ready to escalate: True

WHY
Triage returned False Positive from the Okta activity alone. GEMINI_FINDINGS
later confirmed exfiltration of seven confidential financial and M&A
documents from Salesforce. That evidence supersedes the initial assessment.

OPEN QUESTIONS, not answerable from the SIEM
1. Is the Passkey factor still enrolled, and are sessions from 149.50.97.144
   still active? Needs: Okta. Determines whether the attacker still has access.
2. Did anything malicious run on CYMBAL-LT-HUDSON, and is it contained?
   Needs: CrowdStrike. Determines the compromise vector and endpoint scope.
3. In Salesforce, what happened beyond searching and downloading? Records
   modified, connected apps authorized, other objects accessed?
   Needs: Salesforce. Determines full data impact and any CRM persistence.
4. What cloud resources can this federated identity reach, and did the
   attacker use that path? Needs: Wiz. Blast radius beyond SaaS.

comments.author: Automation
comments.text:
ESCALATED TO TIER 2

Escalation approved by the analyst. Priority raised to Critical. The open
questions above require live platform access.
